title: Yoro Fandar
description: An over-achieving rule follower, Yord Fandor was a highly disciplined and self-serious Jedi Knight dedicated to the rules of the Jedi Order. He was a Padawan at the same time as Osha Aniseya, and his friendship with her did not endear him to her after the accusations of murder. His by-the-book attitude had a habit of clouding his judgment, and even Padawans like Jecki Lon could see it.
